policy.scope: Definitions are attached to source result IDs; reused letters do not have global meanings.
policy.source: Current explicit theorem fields, named-bound metadata, and parameterized-problem definitions; a small number of technical definitions were checked in primary sources.
policy.sourceSymbol: An optional sourceSymbol binds an existing named-bound placeholder to the displayed mathematical symbol without altering the raw source theorem.
policy.functions: An expansion function f or expansion bound f(k) is distinct from the unspecified function used to summarize a parameter-dependent algorithm. The renderer should distinguish the latter if both occur.
policy.unknowns: No definition is fabricated for a symbol lacking a stated role. Constant-only entries may have an empty definition list.
